summary: Ellomay Capital Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting its Q1 2026 financial results and disclosing the completion of the sale of its indirect holdings in Ellomay Luzon Energy Infrastructures Ltd. for approximately NIS 560 million (~$164 million) on May 10, 2026. The sale, which included Dorad Energy Ltd. as the main asset, is treated as discontinued operations. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or specific per-share price is stated. The filing primarily updates financials and segment disclosures; there is no ongoing regulatory timeline or risk-arb angle, as the deal is closed.
